name: Tracxn
description: Access Tracxn's global startup and private market intelligence database. Search companies, legal entities, track funding rounds & exits, identify unicorns and soonicorns, explore sectors, and discover investment trends - all from within Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tracxn to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tracxn to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platform.tracxn.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tracxn MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tracxn provides these MCP tools: resolve_entities, search_acquisitions, search_companies, search_funding_rounds, search_investors, search_ipo_events, search_legal_entities, search_sectors, search_time_series, load_prompt, search_news_events, and search_patents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tracxn?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tracxn in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Tracxn requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tracxn is developed by Tracxn Technologies Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
